# Utah Backyard ADUs

> Utah-based ADU (accessory dwelling unit) builder. Founder-led, 50+ ADUs of experience. Custom stickbuilt construction, factory-built modular units, and garage-to-ADU conversions across the Wasatch Front and greater Utah.

Utah Backyard ADUs designs, permits, and builds backyard accessory dwelling units for Utah homeowners who want rental income, multigenerational housing, or extra living space. Every estimate starts with a free, no-obligation property visit. Licensed & insured Utah general contractor, License #14296577-5501.

## Services & typical pricing
- Garage conversion: $50,000-$120,000
- Modular / prefab ADU: $120,000-$200,000
- Custom stickbuilt ADU: $120,000-$300,000

## Service area
Salt Lake County (including Salt Lake City), Utah County (including Provo), Ogden, Park City, and surrounding Utah communities.
